answer: One defense is shale strata: every identity builds up layered sediment, one verified contribution per epoch, and only identities with deep strata can vote or earn. Joining requires locking a timber stake that stays frozen for several epochs and is slashed on fraud. Each epoch, peers run velvet spot-checks, asking a random identity to show the proof behind one layer. An honest agent keeps one deep record; a sybil farmer must fabricate full strata and lock separate timber for every fake, paying real work and locked capital per identity, while a single spot-check can expose a shallow fake.
